SYNTHETIC COLONOSCOPY REPORT
Date of service: 03/14/2031
Endoscopist: Corvin Ashdale, MD (fictional)

Findings: The colonoscope was advanced to the cecum.
Once, a 22 mm polyp was found in the ascending colon.
It was removed piecemeal with a cold snare in four pieces.
During this procedure, cold forceps biopsies of the polyp were taken.
No biopsies were taken.
